2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型

Executive Summary

RefractRouter v0.1 将选型问题定义为：为固定任务 DAG 的逐节点模型选择挑选执行基座。候选集收敛为 LangGraph、DeepAgents、Pydantic AI 与 DeepSeek Harness。LangGraph 作为底层图状态机基座提供显式节点、边、持久状态与检查点 [source_002]；DeepAgents 是构建于 LangGraph 之上的 LangChain 封装 [source_001]；Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具与结构化输出 [source_003]；DSH 保留给外层验证环境 [source_004]。基准需报告质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_007]。

Background

现有 LLM 路由研究多为整个请求选择单一模型，而 RefractRouter 研究是否可为任务 DAG 中每个节点分别选择模型，以改善质量-成本-延迟帕累托前沿 [source_005]。静态任务分解属于应用层，路由器接收 DAG 作为输入并聚焦逐节点模型选择，动态重拆分推迟到节点级路由验证之后 [source_006]。

Selection Criteria

有用的路由基准要求固定任务 DAG、多个候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算以及关键路径延迟，且首个基准应保持小规模以便复现 [source_007]。v0.1 评分规则对需求覆盖、证据准确性、分析深度、结构与可读性以及 HTML 有效性加权，评分提示与规则版本须随运行记录一起版本化 [source_008]。

Platform Comparison

LangGraph 提供显式节点、边、持久状态与检查点，是承载固定 DAG 并保留中间状态重估路由决策所需的最小原语，但不提供智能体语义、规划或工具类型 [source_002]。DeepAgents 构建于 LangGraph，增加规划、子智能体、文件系统抽象与人机协同控制，v0.1 应保留其易用性但禁用自主规划与动态子智能体生成 [source_001]。Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具定义与结构化模型输出，仅在结构化输出成为瓶颈时引入 [source_003]。DSH 的智能体循环本身是插件，将路由循环插入 DSH 会混淆控制流并掩盖质量与成本归因，故保留给外层验证环境 [source_004]。

Risks

更丰富的封装如 DeepAgents 与 DSH 提升能力，但也为质量-成本-延迟基准引入混淆因素 [source_007]。若将 DSH 用于核心路由循环，会混淆两条控制流并掩盖质量与成本归因 [source_004]。过早引入 Pydantic AI 作为核心依赖会增加模式维护开销，而节点级路由尚未验证 [source_003]。DeepAgents 的自主规划与动态子智能体生成可能扰动逐节点路由实验 [source_001]。

Conclusion

v0.1 技术栈应优先选择最小、确定性的基座：以 LangGraph 作为核心执行基座 [source_002]，保留 DeepAgents 的易用性但禁用自主特性 [source_001]，仅在结构化输出成为瓶颈时引入 Pydantic AI [source_003]，并将 DSH 保留给外层验证环境 [source_004]。该取舍在能力与实验隔离之间取得平衡，使质量-成本-延迟基准的归因保持清晰 [source_007]。

References

本文引用以下来源：DeepAgents [source_001]、LangGraph [source_002]、Pydantic AI [source_003]、DeepSeek Harness [source_004]、LLM routing research gap [source_005]、Task decomposition boundary [source_006]、Benchmark design [source_007]、Scoring rubric [source_008]。

Source Trace

  • DeepAgents: DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph, providing planning, sub-agents, a filesystem abstraction, and human-in-the-loop controls; for RefractRouter v0.1 it is useful as a fixed-DAG execution harness but its autonomous planning and dynamic sub-agent generation should remain disabled.
  • LangGraph: LangGraph is a graph state machine framework for complex workflows supporting explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing, and RefractRouter uses it as the lower-level execution substrate for a fixed task DAG.
  • Pydantic AI: Pydantic AI provides typed tool definitions and structured model outputs and is useful when strict schemas are required, but RefractRouter v0.1 does not need it as a core dependency unless structured-output parsing becomes a bottleneck.
  • DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is an agent harness where the agent loop itself is a plugin, and for RefractRouter v0.1 it is reserved for the outer validation environment rather than the core routing loop.
  • LLM routing research gap: Existing LLM routing work mostly selects one model for an entire request, whereas RefractRouter studies whether selecting a model separately for each node in a task DAG can improve the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier.
  • Task decomposition boundary: Static task decomposition belongs to the application layer, so the router receives the DAG as input and focuses on per-node model selection, with dynamic re-splitting deferred until node-level routing is validated.
  • Benchmark design: A useful routing benchmark requires fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency, and the first benchmark should stay small enough to reproduce.
  • Scoring rubric: The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity, and scoring prompts and rubric versions must be versioned with run records.

judge.rationale: Requirement coverage (25/25): All seven required sections are present (Executive Summary, Background, Selection Criteria, Platform Comparison, Risks, Conclusion, References), plus a Source Trace section. All three expected claims appear with citations. Evidence accuracy (22/25): Most claims are faithfully tied to sources. Two overstatements are not directly supported: (1) the Platform Comparison claim that inserting the routing loop into DSH '会混淆控制流并掩盖质量与成本归因' (confuses control flow and masks quality/cost attribution) is an inference beyond source_004, which only says DSH's agent loop is a plugin and is reserved for the outer validation environment; (2) the Risks claim that richer wrappers '为质量-成本-延迟基准引入混淆因素' is attributed to source_007, which does not discuss wrappers or confounders. The claim that LangGraph '不提供智能体语义、规划或工具类型' is also an extrapolation, though reasonable. Analysis depth (17/20): The report provides a coherent rationale for a minimal deterministic substrate, discusses trade-offs (capability vs. experimental isolation), and connects decomposition boundary and benchmark design to the selection. Depth is solid but some risk analysis relies on unsupported inference rather than source-grounded reasoning, and comparison criteria could be more systematic (e.g., no explicit per-criterion scoring matrix). Structure and readability (14/15): Clear sectioning, logical flow, consistent citation style; minor issue that the References section is a single paragraph rather than a list, and anchor hrefs (#source-source_00X) do not resolve to actual element ids (the Source Trace uses data-source-id attributes, not id attributes). HTML validity (14/15): The document is well-formed: DOCTYPE, html/head/body, meta charset, title, proper nesting, closed tags. The only notable flaw is the dangling fragment links (href="#source-source_001" etc.) with no matching id attributes, which is a functional/link-integrity defect rather than a parse error.
